site.name: 18 G-TAS
site.title: 18 G-TAS is back
site.tagline: Est. 2008. Eighteen years later, 18 G-TAS is back. Help choose the first drop.

home.lead: Est. 2008. Eighteen years later, KZN's own label is back with new designs for two generations, and this time the first drop is chosen by you.
home.shareText: 18 G-TAS is back after 18 years! Help choose the first drop:

peek.title: {count} new designs. Nobody has seen them yet.
peek.titleFallback: New designs. Nobody has seen them yet.
peek.body: The team is narrowing them down right now. Soon you will swipe through the shortlist on your phone: YEBO or CHA. Your swipes help decide what we make.

eiteen.name: EITEEN
eiteen.body: Kasi, pixel, street. Loud colour and big 18s, made for the block.

gtas.name: XVIII · G-TAS
gtas.body: Gold, Roman numerals and monograms. Quiet luxury that lasts.

team.title: The team picks
team.body: Our team ranks every new design in private and builds a shortlist.

public.title: You swipe
public.body: Open the link from our Facebook page or your WhatsApp group. Swipe right for YEBO, left for CHA. No account needed.

final.title: Ten tees drop
final.body: Your votes and the team's picks choose ten tees for the comeback drop: five sublimation, five in other prints.

closing.title: 18 is back. Pass it on.
closing.body: Voting opens soon. Share this with your crew so nobody misses the first drop.
closing.note: Watch our Facebook page and WhatsApp groups for the voting link.
